title: Maria Jose Villarreal - Web Developer
description: Contrata a Maria Jose Villarreal para crear tu aplicación web. Especializada en construir soluciones web responsivas, que combinan un diseño elegante con una navegación intuitiva.
myDescription: from Mendoza, Argentina. I specialize in building responsive web solutions that combine sleek design with intuitive navigation.
educationDescription1: I am currently pursuing a degree in Systems Engineering at the Universidad Tecnológica Nacional, where I am developing a solid understanding of programming, systems analysis, and technology project management.
educationDescription2: As a frontend development specialist, I focus on creating attractive and functional interfaces, improving usability and user interaction across various platforms.
educationDescription3: In my role as a professional developer, I contribute to the complete software development cycle, ensuring that applications run smoothly and meet user needs.
projectDescription1: This web application is a Netflix clone that lets users browse for movies and stream their trailers. Built with Vite for a fast development experience and Firebase for seamless user authentication, it offers a sleek interface for easy navigation. Leveraging The Movie Database API, users can browse for titles while enjoying a responsive design that enhances the viewing experience.
projectDescription2: This web application allows users to explore the Marvel Cinematic Universe by mapping characters and movies interactively. With an easy search feature, users can find specific information about characters and movies. Additionally, it features an attractive design powered by react-slick for smooth navigation.
